scope: Unified production game caller; complete-world short workloads and bounded CPU/build regression; not R3 acceptance or an installed runtime package

source_identity.scope: Selected game/cmake/assets/unit/integration sources plus prior dependency identity set; excludes complete SDK/driver/vendor dependency tree

incremental.error: The initial build was not settled. Rerun after production changes finish.

limits: Native Debug full CTest still fails foundation.files with Win32 1175; paused Fix1 and Q06/budget risks unchanged
Short scheduled workloads do not prove fourteen human gameplay items or fifteen-minute continuous gameplay
No installed runtime package, R3 authorization, default switch, Vulkan delivery or restored integrated-GPU scope
No actual DeviceLost, submission failure or in-flight timeout was triggered
Skipped-frame delayed-sample regression is CPU evidence, not actual gameplay minimize/occlusion evidence
Image metrics are observations without a predefined acceptance tolerance; no all-asset visual or performance equivalence claim
No-collector smoke requests 400 frames but has no independent count or captured debug-output stream
Incremental identities restore selected headers; no claim that earlier mutable executables still match final build bytes
